hook_text: An elephant swallows a fruit whole and walks for kilometres. Why is that good news for the tree?
clip_script: One marula tree near Mbombela. Weavers hang their nests from its branches. Baboons and impala feast on the fallen fruit. Bees carry pollen from flower to flower so new fruit can form. An elephant swallows the fruit and drops the seeds far away in its dung, ready to grow. A dung beetle rolls the dung away and feeds the soil. Animals need plants. Plants need animals. Everyone needs water, soil, air and sunlight. That is interdependence.
visual_style: Whiteboard marula tree in the centre with arrows drawing outward to each animal and back to the tree.
mood: Warm and busy, like a morning watching a crowded bus stop.
pacing: One animal at a time, each with one arrow, ending with the whole web of arrows.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the arrows for a tree near your home.
